lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct vertical white lines are visible across the lateral torso. Spacing is wider on the anterior portion and becomes progressively narrower towards the posterior haunch.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A single Y-shaped bifurcation is visible on the sixth line from the anterior, splitting toward the dorsal ridge. A minor merging of lines occurs on the eleventh and twelfth lines near the dorsal boundary.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The third and fourth lines from the anterior terminate approximately two-thirds of the way down the torso, failing to reach the ventral boundary.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of 7 high-contrast white spots is visible on the posterior haunch, positioned below the vertical line termination points and above the stifle joint.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three spots on the lower mid-thigh align horizontally to form a dashed geometric line parallel to the ventral plane.

other_distinctive_markers: Two distinct white facial spots are located on the cheek area below the eye. Broad white horizontal bands are present on the anterior of the forelegs and the posterior of the hind legs above the hock.
